title: Grand Slam Titles
summary: Count championship wins for each player across four tournament columns; return players with at least one win.
inputFormat: Players(player_id, player_name); Championships(year, Wimbledon, Fr_open, US_open, Au_open) whose cells hold player_id values.
outputFormat: Columns player_id, player_name, grand_slams_count for players with count >= 1.
edgeRules: A player winning in multiple years counts each win.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: player 1 wins in 2020 Wimbledon and 2021 US_open -> grand_slams_count 2.
